scope.model: google/gemma-4-26b-a4b Q8, shared with another local project

interpretation.coarse_sweep: The encoder-derived rays crossed from center to physical right and then across center to physical left.
interpretation.recorded_failure: The final heading was about 4.0 degrees from the starting heading and was rejected by the then-configured 2.5-degree EV3 tolerance.
interpretation.superseded_follow_up: The 5-degree change proposed during this recorded attempt was not the final profile. A later 5-degree trial failed and a 10-degree trial was operator-reported successful, but neither correlated raw result is contained in this artifact.
interpretation.checked_in_state: The EV3RSTORM profile now uses a provisional 10-degree tolerance and model-free tests cover that configuration.
interpretation.evidence_boundary: This file is evidence only for the recorded stopped 2.5-degree attempt. It must not be cited as machine-verifiable evidence for either later tolerance trial or for a complete autonomous obstacle route.
interpretation.validation_status: Historical physical failure retained; current navigation changes are implemented and hardware-free tested, with a fresh physical acceptance artifact pending.
